## 1. Dependency version bumps in root `pom.xml`

All modules pull json-unit from this single property, so the version change propagates everywhere without per-module edits.

## 2. JSON comparison → varargs-style API
json-unit 3.x removed the `withOptions(Options)` overload; `withOptions` now only accepts varargs `(Option, Option...)` or `Collection<Option>` (I confirmed this against the actual `json-unit-assertj-3.2.7.jar` via `javap`). Across **13 JMAP contract source files** I:

## 3. Precise date-time error handling
In `MailboxEventSerializer.scala`, `internalDate` (an `Instant`) previously used play-json's default `Reads[Instant]`, which swallows parse failures into a `JsError` — so an invalid date surfaced as `NoSuchElementException` on `.get()`. I added a custom reads:

```scala
implicit val instantReads: Reads[Instant] = {
  case JsString(value) => JsSuccess(Instant.parse(value))
  case _ => JsError()
}
```

Now a present-but-invalid date-time string lets `Instant.parse`'s `DateTimeParseException` (a `java.time.DateTimeException`) propagate, while a structurally-absent value (`null`/non-string) still yields the structural `NoSuchElementException`.
